literal: And discerning, having chosen, and executing, and decisively declaring, that which is capable of [these] is the minister.
translation: A minister is one who is capable of discerning options, choosing the best course to execute, and declaring it with absolute certainty.
modern: ஒரு செயலை ஆராய்ந்து அறிதலும், அவ்வாறு ஆராய்ந்த பின் சிறந்ததை முடிவு செய்து செய்தலும், அதனைத் துணிவாக எடுத்துச் சொல்லுதலும் வல்லவரே அமைச்சர் ஆவார்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential duties of an ideal minister. First, they must thoroughly analyze and understand a situation or problem (தெரிதல்). Second, after careful deliberation, they must choose the right course of action and execute it successfully (தேர்ந்து செயல்). Finally, they must possess the communication skills to present and defend their decisions with absolute clarity and conviction (ஒருதலையாச் சொல்லல்). Anyone who is capable of performing these three tasks effectively is fit to be a minister.
